title.narrative: Strengthening Domestic Electoral Observation in Sierra Leone

description.narrative: The overall goal of the project is to Strengthen the operational capacity of NEW to observe the 2022 Voter Registration (VR) Process, contribute to the integrity of the Voter Register through a VR Assessment; influence Electoral Reforms and Observe Bye-Election. Specifically, the project seeks to: Continuously capacitate the NEW structure for effective electoral observation and engagement. Deploy observers in segments for the voter registration across the country Share observation findings with EMBs and the public. Conduct a Voter Registration Assessment and follow-up on electoral reforms for peaceful coexistence in Sierra Leone. Consistently engage with relevant stakeholders on the level of implementation of the Election Observation Missions (EOM) recommendations.
